features: Starlight low-light: 0.017 lx colour, 0.0057 lx mono (30 IRE)
720p up to 60 fps; 1280x1024 (5:4) at 30 fps max without IVA
84 dB WDR (100 dB with Intelligent Auto Exposure)
Intelligent Video Analytics (IVA) with Intelligent Tracking and face detection (-BA); MOTION+ (-B)
Content Based Imaging Technology (CBIT), Intelligent Dynamic Noise Reduction
Hybrid operation: simultaneous IP stream + analog CVBS output (SMB)
Auto motorized back focus, lens wizard
Regions of interest / E-PTZ, area-based encoding, upright 9:16 mode
CS-mount (C-mount with adapter ring), DC-iris; lens sold separately
2 alarm inputs, 1 relay output, RS-232/422/485, audio line in/out
ONVIF Profile S, Q and G
dimensions_mm: 78 x 66 x 140 (W x H x L, without lens)

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NBN_71013_Data_sheet_enUS_14410331915.pdf, V15 May 2016). NBN-71013-BA = IVA (Intelligent Video Analytics) version; NBN-71013-B = same camera with MOTION+ only. Power consumption 10.8 W is the IVA model on 24 VAC (4.8-8.4 W for the non-IVA model). Operating temperature -20 to 55 C (-20 to 50 C for IVA). Box camera sold without lens, so no lens/FOV is recorded.
